Fc.bar_b_note: B's larger wrapped text and icon prompts fit the blue-grey translucent UI direction, but the dark rainy night behind it is murky and flat, nothing like Palworld's bright readable HUD-over-world finish.

Up.bar_b_note: The old villager has a clear, appealing face, eyes and earthy meadow palette at a shipping-stylised finish, but on a bare dark stage there is no light or atmosphere to carry the Valheim half.

Pr.bar_b_note: A's timber frame, diagonal brace, cap and stone footing read as a built wall, but the flat beige infill and lone free-standing panel, and B's blown-out white card, sit below Palworld's base-building finish.

Fl.bar_b_note: B's glossy blue scaled body with coral spines is a readable, appealing naturalistic creature, but A's faint-end frame drops to a grey-beige untextured-looking body and A's faint-mid floats above its shadow, and the neutral stage gives no world light.

Kx.bar_b_note: The meadow light and sky are pleasant, but a giant feathered wing fills half the Corin frame, a grey mass blocks the Halder frame and Kell is not identifiable, so the staging sinks it.

Rw.bar_b_note: A clean translucent blue-grey panel with teal selection, readable full recipe lines and clear orange need-counts over a daylit meadow reads like a shipping crafting UI, though the orange 'Missing' tags are small.

Hx.bar_b_note: The landed frame has good meadow grass, path and sky, but the glide frame looks down on a featureless blurred green plane and the landed bird keeps its full spread-wing glide pose instead of perching.

Sl.bar_b_note: The icy-blue Nightburrow shiny separates clearly from its dark striped normal, but the pale Stormtrail shiny is tiny and low-contrast against the sunlit grass and the creatures are small behind a dominating foreground grass carpet.

Lg.bar_b_note: Roads and a village outline now show, but the surveyed area is a flat green disc in a blue-grey cloud fog with no hills, water, groves or landmarks, far from a painted world map.

Ry.bar_b_note: No magenta floor marks and the furred boar and hound are naturalistic and readable, but the hit effects are pale dust puffs that half-hide the boar in grunt-02, the tell still lives in small HUD text and the boar has no strong hit-react pose.

Uv.bar_b_note: A dark grey rock slab fills the right third of the Garrick frame with Garrick not visible behind the player's head, and the quarry-foreman frame is wedged against a brown rock wall with a cropped character in the corner.

top_changes.change: Dialogue camera: collision-aware framing that pulls in or orbits to keep the named speaker unobstructed and centred, culling or fading foreground creatures and rock faces (Kx, Uv)

Ship the A-side homestead wall (timber frame, cap, stone footing) and give the infill a textured, value-broken wattle/plaster material instead of flat beige or white (Pr); keep the B-side Fl material for the creature including faint states
Flyer perch/landing animation with folded wings, plus a painted terrain layer for the map (hills, water, groves, landmarks) under the roads and markers (Hx, Lg)
